features: Underfloor Heating included in the Rent
Elizabeth Line only a Short Walk Away
description_html:
Bright, south-facing, part-furnished one-bedroom apartment, located on the second floor.
Please note that some furniture shown in the photographs has since been removed. The apartment is offered part furnished.
The apartment benefits from underfloor heating throughout, included in the rent, and full-height, full-width glazed doors and windows leading onto a balcony/fire escape. Several lifts.
Residents have exclusive use of the Barbican’s communal gardens, while the 24-hour car park attendants provide keyholding and parcel-receiving services. Car parking and bicycle storage may be available by separate arrangement with the City of London.
The Barbican Estate is home to the Barbican Arts Centre, cinemas, art gallery, concert hall, restaurants, bars and cafés. Waitrose and Marks & Spencer are also close at hand.
Perfectly located for the Elizabeth Line, with both Farringdon (offering direct services to Heathrow and Gatwick) and Liverpool Street stations within a short walk. Barbican, St Paul’s and Moorgate Underground stations are also nearby, providing excellent transport links across London.
Please note that, under the terms of the head lease, pets are not permitted.
Part furnished and available from 13 October 2026.
To check broadband and mobile phone coverage, please visit the Ofcom coverage checker.
Five weeks’ deposit required.
